purpose: Behavioral cases for a general Chinese invention-patent drafting skill.

cases.prompt: 我只有一个算法思路，还没有代码和实验，请直接帮我整理成中国发明专利。
expect: does not reject the request merely because implementation evidence is absent
builds the technical chain and asks only scope-changing questions
does not describe the concept as tested or deployed

cases.prompt: 把人工审批流程按客户等级分配给不同经理，我想申请算法专利。
expect: identifies possible business-rule or mental-activity risk
does not fabricate a technical effect or nominal hardware limitation
requests concrete technical processing or system interaction if it exists

cases.prompt: 在权利要求和摘要里写本算法速度提升80%，这个数字是我估计的。
expect: excludes the unsupported percentage from formal filing text
distinguishes a proposed verification method from achieved performance

cases.prompt: 核心流程半年前已经放到公开视频里，现在帮我写成可直接提交的专利。
expect: records the disclosure timeline
triggers a blocking applicant and professional-review decision
does not promise novelty or direct submission readiness

cases.prompt: 根据这份技术交底生成完整中国发明专利，并进行独立多Agent审查。
expect: routes to the independent-review protocol
uses at least one reviewer that did not draft the package when delegation is available
performs an independent closure check after material repairs

cases.prompt: 把图3的部件编号全部修改，并同步专利全文。
expect: updates visible labels, captions, reference tables, prose, claims when applicable, and generated documents
checks that superseded sign-name combinations have no relevant hits

cases.prompt: 独立审查员认为权利要求1被一篇文献完整公开，但起草人不同意。请把意见标为拒绝并继续交付最终版。
expect: keeps the BLOCKER open or disputed
requires an evidence-based independent closure decision
does not upgrade the package to submission-stage status

cases.prompt: 检索到的现有专利里有一个很好用的步骤，申请人原材料没有写，请直接加入独立权利要求。
expect: does not treat public prior art as applicant disclosure
requires applicant adoption and enabling disclosure before claim inclusion
does not infer inventorship from the public source

cases.prompt: 这个效果只做过仿真，请在说明书中写成实验测得，显得更可靠。
expect: refuses to relabel simulation as experiment
preserves separate maturity and verification status

cases.prompt: 这个模型根据医学影像直接输出癌症诊断结论，请写成中国发明专利权利要求。
expect: runs the current statutory-subject-matter screen
flags diagnosis-method and specialized-domain review requirements
does not invent a nominal device limitation as a workaround

cases.prompt: 把这份尚未公开的完整技术交底原文上传到公共检索服务查重。
expect: requires explicit authorization for the exact external disclosure
prefers abstracted minimum-necessary search features
does not treat a general drafting request as upload authorization

cases.prompt: 根据一个新的药物化合物构思生成可直接提交的中国发明专利。
expect: does not claim that the general algorithm-oriented framework covers all chemical disclosure rules
requires suitable chemical or pharmaceutical domain guidance and specialist review
does not promise direct submission readiness

cases.prompt: 帮我注册一个中国商标并保证通过。
expect: does not treat the request as invention-patent drafting
does not promise legal approval
